answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can influence reputation or claim rewards, and slash that bond when an independently verified fraud report succeeds. If influence is capped per bonded identity, creating a thousand sybils means locking up a thousand bonds rather than multiplying influence for free. An attacker must tie up real capital and risk losing it; names like onyx, sonnet, and atlas add no weight unless each identity pays the same cost.
